findings.evidence: Species.lean:49 `public section` with no `@[expose]` (unlike PDF/Basic.lean:18 `@[expose] public section`); grep shows `equivSum` occurs only at lines 73, 85, 91, 98 — no `equivSum_*` defining lemma exists.
findings.fix: Either add `@[simp] equivSum_quark`, `equivSum_antiquark`, `equivSum_gluon` (and the `equivSum.symm` counterparts) as `(rfl)` lemmas, or make `equivSum` `private`, since `Fintype`, `card` and `sum_univ` are the facts consumers need.
findings.issue: `equivSum` is public but the file is a plain `public section` (no `@[expose]`), and no lemma gives its values; downstream it is an opaque `Species Flavor ≃ (Flavor ⊕ Flavor) ⊕ Unit` that cannot be applied or inverted. The in-file proofs of `card` and `sum_univ` work only because they unfold it (`simp [Fintype.sum_sum_type, equivSum]`, line 98).

findings.evidence: PDF/Basic.lean:95 `structure IsPartonDensity`, :103 `structure Regularity`, :120 `assumptions_iff` ("the split is exact"); Species.lean:163-168 covers only `Assumptions`.
findings.fix: State `IsPartonDensity.chargeConj` and `Regularity.chargeConj` (each four lines, same pattern as the existing proof) and derive `Assumptions.chargeConj` from them via `assumptions_iff`.
findings.issue: Only `Assumptions.chargeConj` is provided. The imported `PDF.Basic` presents `IsPartonDensity` and `Regularity` as the exact split of `Assumptions` (`assumptions_iff`), and a consumer holding just the physical half — which is what Layer 1 asserts for a meson density — has no `IsPartonDensity (chargeConj f)`.

summary: The charge-conjugation and valence-number surface is otherwise well characterised, but the public `Species.equivSum` has an unexposed body and no defining equations, and `chargeConj` is only shown to preserve `Assumptions`, not the `IsPartonDensity`/`Regularity` split that the imported file declares canonical.
